CHILD CUSTODY AGREEMENT

This Child Custody Agreement is made on February 5, 2026, between Maria Gonzalez (hereinafter "Mother") and Robert Nguyen (hereinafter "Father"), collectively referred to as the "Parents."

RECITALS

WHEREAS, the Parents have two minor children: Sofia, born on 06/12/2018, and Lucas, born on 11/03/2020;

WHEREAS, Mother resides at 500 Pine Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90001 and Father resides at 78 Maple Dr, Pasadena, CA 91101;

WHEREAS, Mother is employed by Global Health Inc with an annual income of $82,000, and Father is employed by Pacific Engineering with an annual income of $97,500;

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parents agree as follows:

1. CUSTODY. The Parents shall share joint legal custody of Sofia and Lucas. Mother shall have primary physical custody.

2. VISITATION. Father shall have visitation every other weekend and alternating holidays.

3. CHILD SUPPORT. Father agrees to pay child support in the amount of $2,800/month.

4. EDUCATION. Both Parents agree to consult regarding educational decisions for Sofia and Lucas.

5. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parents have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

Mother: Maria Gonzalez
Father: Robert Nguyen
